name: market-pro
description: Sistema de minimarket multi-tenant, modular y basado en microservicios estilo AWS Lambda (API Gateway v2).

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontends
scripts.build:frontends: npm run build -w @market-pro/frontend-admin && npm run build -w @market-pro/frontend-backoffice && npm run build -w @market-pro/frontend-pos
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b backend/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w @market-pro/frontend-admin && npm run typecheck -w @market-pro/frontend-backoffice && npm run typecheck -w @market-pro/frontend-pos
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres
